_comment: Default bindings for the controller this package declares, in the shape of the other
packages': player one only, and the console switches on the keys nearest them.

The joystick is also on the first game controller: the directional pad and the left stick are the directions, A is the button, Start is Reset and Back is Select. Power, the difficulty switches and the TV type stay on the keyboard (chimera#336).

Atari 2600 Controller.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV0U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Atari 2600 Controller.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV0D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Atari 2600 Controller.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV0L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Atari 2600 Controller.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV0R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
